items.summary: Add a 'category' field to the Product type in backend/main.mo as a separate field distinct from the shape field, storing category as Text type
Update the createProduct backend method in backend/main.mo to accept and store the category field when creating new products
Update the updateProduct backend method in backend/main.mo to support updating the category field independently from other product fields
Update the BulkProductUpload component (frontend/src/components/BulkProductUpload.tsx) to include a separate category input field for each uploaded product alongside the existing shape field

Update the ProductManagementTable component (frontend/src/components/ProductManagementTable.tsx) to display the category field as a separate column and support inline editing of category independently from shape

Add a separate 'Category' filter section in the Marketplace page (frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx) header alongside the existing 'Shape' filter section, displaying all unique category values as clickable filter tabs
Update the filter logic in Marketplace.tsx to support filtering products by both shape and category independently, where products must match selected shape filters AND selected category filters
Update the ProductCard component (frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx) to display both shape and category information on each product card
Update the ProductDetailView component (frontend/src/components/ProductDetailView.tsx) to display both shape and category fields in the product detail modal
Update all React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts to handle the new category field in product data structures for fetching and mutating products
